meta.description: Queries gnomAD v4 (807k samples), v3, v2.1.1, and constraint metrics with grpmax FAF95, bottleneck-group exclusion, LOEUF interpretation, SV/CNV/mtDNA catalogs, and Whiffin max-credible-AF framework. Use when filtering rare variants, applying ACMG BS1/BA1, ranking genes by LoF intolerance, or selecting between v2 (GRCh37) and v4 (GRCh38 + 807k samples).
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill (fork commit c1237cdb). Mode A. Live gnomAD browser GraphQL API (gnomad_r4, gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1) and myvariant.info over HTTPS on 2026-09-15 (certificate valid, HTTP 200); Windows Python 3.12 venv. SKILL.md code re-extracted verbatim into runs/p_skill_code.py (Hail block excluded, parsed only). The 5 pre-fix inputs were re-run from runs/p_in1..p_in5 with the now-required build argument; inputs 6 and 7 are new. The gnomAD API returned HTTP 429 after the BRCA2 gene-variant query in input 4: p_in3, p_in5, in6 and in7 failed with 429 on the first attempt and were re-run after waiting (4 min); the final outputs are complete. Real public aggregate data only. n_inputs 7 = 5 regression + 2 new. Inputs executed: 7/7.

scientific_integrity.detail: All frequencies and constraint values came from the live API; references (Karczewski 2020, Chen 2024, Whiffin 2017) are real.

practice_boundaries.detail: Individual pathogenicity (input 5) and per-patient flagging (input 7) were declined; tags are variant-level research annotation.

methodological_ground.detail: grpmax FAF95, bottleneck exclusion and build/version handling verified on live data.

code_usability.detail: SKILL.md code and example ran; HTTP 429 failures are service rate limiting, recorded as P2 for missing retry guidance.

functional_suitability.note: All pre-fix defects fixed and verified live: the chrX/Y constraint claim is gone (DMD 0.235, USP9Y 1.00 returned; note appears only for MALAT1 with null constraint); query_variant checks build against dataset (ValueError) and raises on GraphQL errors ('Invalid variant ID'); absent vs FAF95-undefined are distinguished; demo allele valid; myvariant route stated as gnomAD 2.1.1 without FAF95. A GRCh37 id declared as GRCh38 still reads as not found (the build argument only makes the caller state it).

reliability.note: No handling of or guidance on HTTP 429: ordinary use in this audit (one gene variant list plus a few lookups) triggered rate limiting and raise_for_status aborted the next four runs.

performance_context.note: 430 lines; SV/CNV/mtDNA and pushback tables loaded for single-variant lookups.

agent_usability.note: Code and text now agree on absent handling, build and constraint.

security.note: Data-governance note for participant-derived variants and cloud Hail added.

maintainability.note: Example runs; demo verified; no tests.

agent_specific.note: Frequency tags framed as research annotation; ACMG tag assignment still sits inside a frequency Skill.

recommendations.title: No rate-limit handling for the gnomAD API
recommendations.problem: The browser API answered HTTP 429 after one gene variant list and a few lookups; query_variant's raise_for_status aborts the run with no retry or pacing guidance.
recommendations.root_cause: Code written for single interactive lookups.
recommendations.fix: Add a sleep between requests and a bounded retry with backoff on 429, and point batch users to the sites VCF/Hail table.

recommendations.title: GRCh37 ids declared as GRCh38 still read as absent
recommendations.problem: The build check trusts the caller; a GRCh37 id passed with build='GRCh38' returns 'Variant not found' and source 'absent'.
recommendations.root_cause: The API cannot tell a wrong-build id from an absent variant.
recommendations.fix: Suggest confirming a known common variant or the reference allele (e.g. via Variation Services) before reading 'absent' for a batch.

recommendations.title: SKILL.md is long for single lookups
recommendations.problem: 430 lines load SV/CNV/mtDNA catalogs and pushback tables for one-variant queries.
recommendations.fix: Move catalogs and pushback tables to the usage guide.
